run_dqn_agent_on_android_env: run a DQN agent on AndroidEnv using acme EnvironmentLoop for a specified number of episodes
apply_wrappers_to_environment: apply discrete action, image rescale, float pixels, and single precision wrappers to an environment
configure_android_emulator: configure an Android emulator with AVD name, SDK root, and ADB path via config classes
create_dqn_agent: create a DQN agent with an Atari network for a given environment spec and action count
run_acme_environment_loop: run an acme EnvironmentLoop with a DQN agent over a configured AndroidEnv for N episodes
